name: Is AI Search only for large contracting firms, or can small businesses use it?

mainEntity.name: Is AI Search only for large contracting firms, or can small businesses use it?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI Search optimization is highly beneficial for contracting businesses of all sizes, including small and medium-sized firms. While larger firms may have bigger budgets, AI tools can be scaled to fit various needs and budgets. For smaller businesses, AI can level the playing field by efficiently identifying niche opportunities and optimizing for local searches, helping them compete effectively against larger companies in their service areas. It democratizes access to advanced digital marketing techniques.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI Search optimization is effective for contractors of all sizes. It helps small businesses compete by identifying niche opportunities and optimizing for local searches within their budget.
